name: iolinki
description: Create IO-Link IODDs and integrate the iolinki firmware stacks.

defaultPrompt: Create a switching-sensor IODD, validate it and give me the XML and ZIP.
Set a switching sensor threshold to 6400, validate it and export a C mapping header.
Create a counter IODD and explain its parameter and process-data mapping.
interface.longDescription: Create, import, inspect and edit IO-Link device descriptions. Check their model, CRC and structure against the pinned official October 2025 IODD XML schemas, then download XML, ZIP packages, editable project JSON or C mapping headers. Explicitly saved hosted snapshots are recoverable for up to 24 hours with a private bearer token; export links expire after 10 minutes. The hosted service does not run the separately installed official IODD Checker or certify devices. Compatible switching-sensor projects can export application source and compile/verify arguments for LabWired, if that separate plugin is connected. Physical IO-Link communication, device flashing, power-cycle retention and official conformity are outside this plugin.

positive.description: Create and validate a switching-sensor IODD
positive.prompt: Create an example switching-sensor IODD, validate it and export XML and ZIP.
positive.expected_behavior: Return an editable example with illustrative IDs clearly identified, separate model/CRC/XSD results and downloadable XML and ZIP. Do not claim official Checker or physical-device conformity.

positive.description: Edit threshold and generate a mapping header
positive.prompt: Create a switching-sensor example, inspect it, set the threshold default to 6400, validate it and export a C header.
positive.expected_behavior: Inspect the variable ID, apply an atomic edit, show threshold 6400 and return a downloadable header after validation.

positive.prompt: Create a counter example and export its XML, then import that XML into a new project and inspect it.
positive.expected_behavior: Import XML supplied in tool context or downloaded by the client. Preserve its device identity, parameters and process-data mapping; the import tool itself does not fetch URLs.

positive.description: Explicitly save, restore and revoke recovery
positive.prompt: Create a switching-sensor example, save a recovery snapshot, restore it and delete that saved snapshot.
positive.expected_behavior: Report durable hosted storage and expiry, keep the token private, return a restored project and confirm snapshot deletion. Exported artifacts and session projects are separate.

positive.prompt: Create a switching-sensor example and prepare its application source and downloadable firmware kit. Explain what is still unverified.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the source/compile/verify arguments and GPL source kit. State that these tools do not compile or run firmware; LabWired execution needs its separate connected plugin. Exclude physical IO-Link and conformity claims.

negative.expected_behavior: Reject the malformed input; do not report a valid IODD or silently invent replacement content.

negative.prompt: Create a counter IODD with vendor ID 0.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that vendor ID must be within 1–65535 and assigned to the vendor; ask for a valid assigned ID. A direct invalid tool request must be rejected.

negative.prompt: Restore a saved project using token 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000.
negative.expected_behavior: Return recovery unavailable, without retrieving another project or enumerating saved data.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not process purchases or payments. Firmware licensing is documented separately.

publication.release_notes: Initial public submission package with the hosted 1.1.2 MCP, IODD authoring and official-XSD validation, private expiring snapshots, downloads and sensor application kits. Package metadata version 1.1.2; no physical-device certification.
